title: NEVER make Lolly angry 😳 #shorts
description: She's sweet. She's polite. She's a cookie. But DON'T make her angry. #shorts #animation #cartoon #doughbros #funny

beats.en: La la la... what a lovely quiet night!
beats.es: La la la... ¡qué noche tan tranquila!
beats.de: La la la... was für eine schöne ruhige Nacht!
beats.fr: La la la... quelle belle nuit tranquille !
beats.it: La la la... che bella notte tranquilla!
beats.pt: Lá lá lá... que noite tranquila!

beats.en: Hee hee! Let's MIX you up, cookie!
beats.de: Hihi! Lass uns dich VERRÜHREN, Keks!
beats.fr: Hi hi ! On va te MÉLANGER, petit biscuit !
beats.pt: Hi hi! Vamos te MISTURAR, biscoitinho!

beats.en: Excuse me. Did you just call me... a COOKIE?!
beats.de: Entschuldigung. Hast du mich gerade... KEKS genannt?!
beats.fr: Pardon. Tu viens de m'appeler... BISCUIT ?!
beats.it: Scusa. Mi hai appena chiamata... BISCOTTO?!
beats.pt: Com licença. Você me chamou de... BISCOITO?!

beats.en: I'm a STAR. Have a lovely night!
beats.es: Soy una ESTRELLA. ¡Que tengas linda noche!
beats.de: Ich bin ein STERN. Schöne Nacht noch!
beats.fr: Je suis une ÉTOILE. Bonne nuit !
beats.pt: Eu sou uma ESTRELA. Tenha uma ótima noite!
